history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration enhance the Case Management Tracking System to ensure accurate data capture to enable the formalization of the timely assessment of prohibited conduct key performance indicator as soon as possible.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration enhanced the Case Management Tracking System with a new data field called “Date of decision for no investigation”. Together with existing data fields capturing steps related to reports of alleged prohibited conduct where an investigation takes place, the new data field makes it possible to measure the overall timeliness of assessments and subsequent decisions by heads of entity regarding whether or not to initiate an investigation within three months of receipt of the report from the Office of Internal Oversight Services, as provided in section 5.5 (e) of the Secretary-General’s bulletin on addressing discrimination, harassment, including sexual harassment, and abuse of authority (ST/SGB/2019/8). In addition, conduct and discipline teams across all entities were briefed in September/October 2025 on how to use and update Case Management Tracking System data fields, and a data maintenance exercise was subsequently carried out to achieve data accuracy, with clear guidance provided to entities on data accuracy continuity. A quality assurance procedure was also established to this effect.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has enhanced the functionality of the Case Management Tracking System and established a quality assurance framework to ensure data accuracy for the formalized key performance indicator, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
